scheme_name: Dattopant Thengadi Mratak Shramik Aarthik Sahayata Yojana
description:
The Dattopant Thengadi Mratak Shramik Aarthik Sahayata Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Maharashtra. 

This scheme was initiated on 1st January 2020. 

It is named after Dattopant Thengadi, a prominent trade union leader and social worker. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the families of deceased unorganized sector workers. 

The scheme aims to support the families who have lost their primary breadwinners. 

The government has set a target to provide assistance to at least 50,000 families annually. 

Under this scheme, the financial assistance provided is ₹1 lakh. 

This amount is intended to help families cope with the immediate financial burden following the loss of a family member. 

The assistance is aimed at ensuring that the families can sustain themselves during a challenging time. 

Eligibility for the scheme is primarily focused on unorganized sector workers. 

The deceased worker must have been engaged in unorganized work at the time of their death. 

The age limit for eligibility is set at a minimum of 18 years. 

There is no upper age limit specified for the deceased worker. 

Income criteria are also established for eligibility. 

The annual income of the deceased worker should not exceed ₹1.5 lakh. 

This income limit ensures that the assistance reaches those who are genuinely in need. 

The application process for the Dattopant Thengadi Mratak Shramik Aarthik Sahayata Yojana is straightforward. 

Applicants must fill out a designated application form. 

The application form can be obtained from the local labor office or downloaded from the official government website. 

Along with the application form, several documents are required. 

These documents include the death certificate of the deceased worker. 

A copy of the worker's identity proof is also necessary. 

Proof of income must be submitted to verify the income criteria. 

Additionally, a bank account statement of the deceased worker may be required. 

Once the application is completed with the necessary documents, it should be submitted to the local labor office. 

The local labor office will then verify the application and documents submitted. 

The verification process typically takes about 30 days. 

Upon successful verification, the financial assistance will be disbursed. 

The disbursement is made directly to the bank account of the eligible family member. 

The scheme is implemented by the Labour Department of Maharashtra. 

The department is responsible for overseeing the application process and disbursement of funds. 

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the Labour Department. 

The contact details for the Labour Department can be found on the official Maharashtra government website. 

The Dattopant Thengadi Mratak Shramik Aarthik Sahayata Yojana is part of a broader initiative to support unorganized workers. 

The government recognizes the vulnerabilities faced by unorganized sector workers and their families. 

This scheme is one of several measures taken to improve the welfare of this demographic. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is crucial for families during their time of need. 

It helps them to manage expenses related to daily living and other unforeseen costs. 

The scheme also aims to reduce the economic impact of sudden loss on families. 

By providing immediate financial support, the government seeks to stabilize the affected families. 

The scheme is a testament to the government’s commitment to social welfare. 

It reflects an understanding of the challenges faced by unorganized workers. 

The government continues to monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of the scheme. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further. 

The Dattopant Thengadi Mratak Shramik Aarthik Sahayata Yojana is an essential component of Maharashtra's welfare policies. 

It is designed to provide timely assistance to those who need it most. 

The scheme underscores the importance of social security for unorganized workers. 

It aims to create a safety net for families in distress. 

The financial support can also help in covering educational expenses for children. 

This aspect is particularly important for families who may struggle to afford schooling after a loss. 

The scheme is aligned with the government’s broader goals of poverty alleviation. 

It seeks to empower families by providing them with the means to sustain themselves. 

The Dattopant Thengadi Mratak Shramik Aarthik Sahayata Yojana is a significant step towards ensuring social justice. 

It aims to uplift the living standards of families affected by the loss of their primary earners. 

The scheme is expected to evolve with changing needs and circumstances. 

The government remains committed to enhancing the welfare of unorganized workers through various initiatives. 

Overall, the Dattopant Thengadi Mratak Shramik Aarthik Sahayata Yojana represents a proactive approach to social welfare in Maharashtra. 

It is a critical resource for families navigating the challenges of losing a loved one. 

The scheme exemplifies the government's dedication to supporting its citizens during difficult times. 

In conclusion, the Dattopant Thengadi Mratak Shramik Aarthik Sahayata Yojana is a vital welfare initiative. 

It provides essential financial assistance to families of deceased unorganized workers. 

This scheme plays a crucial role in ensuring the economic stability of affected families. 

The government continues to promote and support this initiative to reach more beneficiaries. 

The commitment to social welfare remains a priority for the Maharashtra government.
